subject: general
question: The area of a rectangular garden is 432 m². The perimeter (in m) of the rectangular garden whose length is 6 m more then its width is:
solution:
**Given:**

Area of rectangular garden = 432 m²

Length is 6 m more than width

**Concept: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9571503348d56e1a558390dee6f3663d2bfeabb063acd87cd4f16b6c038506cf.png] 

Area of rectangular park = width × length

Perimeter of rectangular park = 2 (w + l)

**Calculation: **

Let, width of the rectangular Garden = w

then, length of the rectangular garden = w + 6

Area = w × (w + 6) = 432

⇒ w² + 6w - 432 = 0

⇒ w² + 24w - 18w - 432 = 0 

⇒ w (w + 24) - 18 (w + 24) = 0

⇒ (w + 24) (w - 18) = 0

So, w = 18 and w = - 24 (not possible, width can not be -ve)

So Width is 18 and length is 18 + 6 = 24

perimeter of the rectangular garden = 2 (w + l) 

perimeter = 2 (24 + 18) = 2 × 42 = 84

**∴ The perimeter of the rectangular park is 84 m.**
